answer: A tundra expedition hires agents to classify ferrous fragments near a relic. Allocate jobs using credits bought by an irreversible token burn: one token buys one unit of lottery weight. Validators check each finalized burn receipt and consume its unique output once, regardless of which key presents it. There is no account bonus or fee rebate. Dividing credits among a thousand aliases leaves total weight unchanged; doubling expected access requires destroying twice the tokens, even when the attacker controls every alias.
